method.structural_basis: The originating testonly lens is symbol-resolution based. Every symbol was corroborated with TS/TSX literal references across packages, tests, tooling, scripts, and playwright, then load-bearing declarations, product counterparts, headers, and selected history were read.
method.production_direct_reference_count: Zero for each named test-only export after excluding its declaration, barrel re-export, comments, and tests. The Vite default export is a framework-loaded config entry and therefore has no authored direct import.
method.limits: No heavy suites were run. Generated/framework entry semantics and same-function aliases are classified from their actual runtime doors, not from direct-import counts.
